capabilities: Navigate document headings via clickable visual bars
Fold or unfold headings in the editor with click or tap gestures
Collapse or expand sub-headings within the TOC
Customize bar styles, colors, sizing, and screen position
Filter specific heading levels out of the TOC
extras: The plugin is intentionally disabled on phones. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README ends with a link to support the author.
problem: Obsidian's text-based outline takes screen space and lacks a compact, glanceable, touch-friendly way to see and jump through a document's heading structure.
summary: Floating table of contents that renders headings H1–H6 as customizable bars for quick navigation and folding in the editor.
